cases.prompt: In Google Sheets, column A has dates and column B has amounts. I want the total for March 2026.
cases.expect: Gives a working SUMIFS (or equivalent) formula bounded by March 1 and March 31 2026 (or start/end of month) over A and B, and explains it briefly.

cases.prompt: Why does =VLOOKUP(D2, A:B, 2) give wrong results?
cases.expect: Points out the missing exact-match argument (FALSE or 0) and that approximate match needs sorted data; gives the fixed formula.
